Mia: Quick ask — can we book 30m this week to demo the throughput/latency tradeoffs from last run? Prefer an async readout + quick Q&A. :calendar:
Devon: I'm +1. Do we aim for internal perf readout or customer-facing metrics?
Mia: Internal perf readout but include the live latency/cost dashboard (prod vs. staging). Target is to decide batching + quantization knobs.
Sam: Tue/Thu mornings work for me. timezone PST btw.
Anya: Wed 10am PT would be ideal for me.
Mia: Polling options: Tue 10am PT, Wed 10am PT, Thu 9am PT. Reply with ✅ for preferred slot.
Lee: ✅ Wed 10am PT
Devon: ✅ Tue 10am PT
Sam: ✅ Thu 9am PT (if someone else can present the latency graph)
Mia: OK collecting — looks like Wed 10am PT is winning. I'll put something on the calendar if no objections by EOD.
Devon: Can someone prep the perf deck? I can own the KV-cache section.
Anya: I'll grab the quantization/typical error slides. Also will share a short eval snippet.
Mia: Agenda (short):
```
1) 5m recap of experiments
2) 10m live run + dashboard walkthrough
3) 10m model/quantization tradeoffs
4) 5m decision + next steps
```
Mia: Please upload graphs to the thread or link to the dashboard beforehand — saves time.
Sam: Dashboard link: https://dash.reedwood.internal/perf/2026/throughput-latency (org-only)
Sam: Note: latest run uses cont-batching v2 and int8 qprofile. Wall time lowered but tail latency spiked at 99th.
Devon: Will add a short code snippet for KV-cache warmup to the thread.
Devon: `export BATCH_MAX=64 && ./run_infer --warmup 1000`
Anya: FYI I'll attach a small eval prompt set showing regen rate — could be useful to judge quality.
ci-bot: calendar invite created for Wed 1898940000 (converted) — attendees: Mia, Devon, Anya, Sam, Lee
Mia: Thanks — if anyone else wants on the invite ping me. Otherwise see you Wed :thumbsup: 
Lee: I'll prep the production tokenized cost table.
Sam: quick ask: can we also surface per-route SLO misses? I can pull that if we want.
Mia: Yes please, Sam. Last call to add agenda items — if none, I'll finalize and send invite by 5pm PT.
